MotorTxOverride.description: Override block for CAN transmit fields. Each value replaces its transmit field only while its enable byte is nonzero. vcu_drive_command_update applies the overrides at the end of each tick. The block is probably written by the receive or diagnostic path.

fields.name: tx184_byte6_override
fields.description: Replacement for byte 6 of CAN frame 0x184 (the low byte of DAT_20001f8c). Used when override_en_a8 is nonzero.

fields.name: tx184_word_override
fields.description: Replacement for payload bytes 4..5 of CAN frame 0x184 (DAT_20001f8e). Used when override_en_a9 is nonzero.

fields.name: txf96_high_override
fields.description: Replacement for the high byte of the output word DAT_20001f96 (the CAN 0x100 field), used when override_en_aa is nonzero.

fields.name: tx184_byte7_override
fields.description: Replacement for byte 7 of CAN frame 0x184 (DAT_20001fee), used when override_en_ae is nonzero.

fields.name: tx184_byte0_override
fields.description: Replacement for byte 0 of CAN frame 0x184 (DAT_20001fef), used when override_en_b2 is nonzero.
